# Freelance Lead Tracker: never lose a lead to silence

> Free freelance lead tracker: a simple pipeline from new lead to won, who to follow up today, a weighted income forecast, win rate by lead source and a one-click hand-off into a proposal. No account, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
